questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 5 advise when going to the house of God?
options: Guard your steps; be quick to listen rather than offer the sacrifice of fools
Bring along your very finest offering and pay all of your vows generously
Pour out all your heart before him with very many words and with long prayers
Approach him boldly and freely, for God greatly delights in the bold of heart
questions.answer: Guard your steps; be quick to listen rather than offer the sacrifice of fools

questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 5 say about the lover of money?
options: He will sleep sweetly, whether he eats little or much
He will be honored above the poor and the wise
He will gain rest and security for his old age
He will never be satisfied with money or income
questions.answer: He will never be satisfied with money or income

questions.question: Ecclesiastes 5 advises being quick to make vows to God.
He who loves money will not be _____ with money.
When you vow a vow to God, do not delay paying it, for he has no pleasure in _____.
